root.label: U.S. revokes visa of Brazil’s ambassador

events.label: U.S. revokes visa of Brazil’s ambassador

slots.name: visa status
slots.sentence: The visa of the Brazilian ambassador, Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti, was canceled in response to her country’s decision to stall the approval of President Trump’s newly appointed ambassador to Brazil and refuse entry recently to several other U.S. diplomats, said a senior State Department official.
